## 04 – Deployment Correlation (owner: Tharindu)
Commits + GitHub Actions runs (when `GITHUB_OWNER`/`GITHUB_REPO` are set) and local releases recorded by `monitoring/scripts/release.sh` (`GET /api/machine/deployments`, signed) before the incident. "Suspect" = within `DEPLOY_SUSPECT_MINUTES`; a local release is the strongest signal (rollback). Correlation is a **possible** cause, never a confirmed one.

nodes.name: When called by 05 Root Cause
nodes.notes: Input: { incident_id, service_name, alert_name, severity, started_at }

nodes.name: Build GitHub requests
nodes.notes: Two GitHub requests, or one { kind: none } item when GitHub is not configured.

nodes.name: GitHub API
nodes.notes: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits and /actions/runs. Credential: fine-grained token, read-only.

nodes.name: Sign local releases request
nodes.notes: Keeps the GitHub responses; signs GET /api/machine/deployments for the lookback window.
